newsitem.title: USA: US Democratic Senator urges Fed not to raise rates.
newsitem.headline: US Democratic Senator urges Fed not to raise rates.

text.p: A Democratic lawmaker on Friday urged the Federal Reserve not to raise interest rates next week.

"With a balanced budget deal in place ... there is no reason for the Fed to raise interest rates on hard-working American families for a second time," Sen. Tom Harkin for Iowa said in a press release.

The central bank raised short-term interest rates in March for the first time in more than two years in a move aimed at staying a step ahead of inflation. It meets again on Tuesday to decide whether a further increase is needed.
